about_the_game:
An all new heroine type, the "Active, Sporty Tomboy" (a.k.a. Tomboy) makes her appearance in Custom Order Maid 3D2! 

This DLC lets you hire a "Tomboy" maid the same way you would a "Muku," "Majime," or "Rindere" maid!

～Who is this Active, Sporty Tomboy?～

Cheerful, fun-loving, and outgoing, this maid acts like everyone's her friend. But she's no meathead; she has the sensitive, easily-embarrassed heart of an innocent maiden. Master's naughty comments will make her blush, but generally speaking, she's honest and straightforward. She's no different when it comes to romance: she's looking for a sweet, loving partner who won't play games with her.

• You can enjoy seeing your Tomboy maid train, talk with other maids on the job, and work at your Empire Club!

• Playable events are available before becoming a lover with Tomboy, such as a love story and events where Tomboy interacts with other maids!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains adult content intended for individuals 18 years of age or older.
It includes nudity, sex scenes, and blatantly sexual imagery, as well as imagery that has sexual implications. Some scenes may be interpreted as non-consensual sex. Please be advised that there may be BDSM scenes in this DLC. If you are uncomfortable with the above content, we recommend you refrain from playing.
If you are not yet 18+ or if you are accessing from any country or located where adult material is specifically prohibited by law, do not play this game.
